name: Xiaoyuan Lian Wuyu
source:
Campus love is not so much interest entanglement, only pure I love you and you love me.

Love in School tells a short love story, simple and fresh.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899940/]Steam[/url]]

校园爱情讲述了一个简短的爱情故事，简单又清新。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899940/]Steam[/url]]
